actual: QE custom evolution accepts node_parallelism=4, but qe_active_execution_capacity hard-codes WSL_BACKTEST_HARD_CAPACITY=2 and silently applies min(requested_limit, hard_cap). This violates the approved dual-node pure-backtest execution contract and leaves two WSL loops queued despite sufficient resources. Make the WSL pure-backtest hard capacity explicitly configurable with validated fail-closed bounds, preserve safe defaults and training/GAT limits, add focused capacity/coordinator tests, and do not restart or rerun the current experiment.
